Film de protection de peinture

Film de protection de peinture

Self-healing film for high-impact areas or the entire vehicle — invisible until it saves your paint.

Packages

Two ways to cover it.

Partial Front PPF

Hood, fenders, mirrors and front bumper — the zone that takes the most rock-chip impact.

Coverage: Front-end panels · Warranty: 10 yr clarity

Full Vehicle PPF

Every painted panel covered in self-healing film that shrugs off light swirl marks with heat.

Coverage: Full body · Warranty: 10 yr clarity
Why PPF

Invisible until the day it saves your paint.

Paint protection film is a thick, optically clear urethane applied to the panels that take the most abuse — bumper, hood, fenders, mirrors and rocker panels — or the entire vehicle. Rock chips, bug etching and light scratches stop at the film. Its top coat self-heals light swirls with heat from the sun or a hot rinse.

We cut film on plotter patterns specific to your vehicle’s year and trim, so edges are wrapped around panels rather than cut on the paint.

Rock-chip proof

8 mil urethane absorbs impacts that would chip clear coat.

Self-healing top coat

Light swirls and scuffs disappear with warmth.

Hydrophobic

Sheds water and road grime; stays clear for a decade.

Computer-cut patterns

Vehicle-specific templates — no blades on your paint.

Coverage options

Choose how much of the vehicle to protect.

Partial frontFull bumper, 18–24 in of hood and fenders, mirror caps
Full frontFull bumper, full hood, full fenders, mirrors, headlights
Track packFull front plus rocker panels, A-pillars, roof leading edge, rear wheel arches
Full bodyEvery painted panel; optional matte finish film for a satin look
CareWash after 48 hours; no wax with abrasives; ceramic coat on top is recommended
  1. Paint correctionNew vehicles get a decontamination wash; used ones get a light polish so defects aren’t sealed under the film.
  2. Pattern cutFilm is plotter-cut to your exact year / trim so panel edges are wrapped, not trimmed on paint.
  3. InstallApplied wet in a dust-controlled bay; edges tucked; film squeegeed and heat-set.
  4. Cure & inspect48 hours to cure. Any moisture pockets clear on their own within a week.

Questions fréquentes

Questions we get asked most.

Still unsure? Send us a note and we’ll answer within one business day.

All FAQsContactez-nous
Can you see the film?
On a properly installed job, no — the edges are wrapped around panel edges and the film is optically clear. A close look at the hood may show a faint edge line on partial-front packages, which is why many customers choose full-hood coverage.
How long does PPF last?
XPEL Ultimate Plus carries a 10-year manufacturer warranty against yellowing, cracking and delamination. Most installs outlast that.
Does it yellow?
Older films did. Modern urethane films with a UV-stable top coat don’t yellow within their warranty period.
PPF or ceramic coating?
They do different jobs. Ceramic coating makes washing easier and adds gloss but doesn’t stop rock chips. PPF stops chips. The best result is PPF on the front with ceramic over everything.
Can I get PPF over a wrap?
Yes, on a fresh wrap — it’s a common combination for matte colour changes that need protection from stains.
